_description: P0 eval-corpus bootstrap, category: slide-decks. Source doc: Stephen Jones, 'CUDA: New Features and Beyond', GTC 2024. Authored 2026-05-21; first real query set against the Memex eval harness.
_chunk_id_provenance: For each answerable query, `memex search --k 3 <question>` was run; chunks with rerank_score > 0.5 that contain the answer are listed in relevant_chunk_ids. Low-rerank cases (qids slide-decks-02 and slide-decks-05) are kept intentionally to expose retrieval-quality baselines.

queries.question: What is the energy cost of FP16 matrix multiplication relative to FP32, in FMA operations?
queries._expected_answer: 0.5x (from the Energy per FLOP table for matrix multiply)

queries.question: What are the two main categories where modern processors spend power, according to the slides?
queries._note: Low rerank score — agent may over-refuse. This is a known retrieval-quality finding to capture in the baseline.

queries.question: How does the power cost of floating point arithmetic scale with the mantissa length?
queries._expected_answer: Power of floating point arithmetic generally scales as the square of the mantissa length.

queries.question: What changed about transistor density and power efficiency between 2004 and 2022, per the TSMC chart?
queries._expected_answer: Transistor density grew massively (120x), but transistors got less power-efficient over the same window; the deck calls out this divergence as the energy-efficiency motivation.

queries.question: Why is data movement a key concern for power efficiency in modern processors?
queries._expected_answer: Modern processors spend significant power on data movement (one of the two categories of power consumption); reducing it is one of the headline strategies in the deck.
queries._note: Borderline rerank score (0.57) — useful test of refusal threshold calibration.

queries.question: What is the energy cost of FP8 tensor core matrix multiplication relative to an FP32 FMA?
queries._expected_answer: 0.06x (from the Energy per FLOP table; Tensor Core MMA in FP8).

queries.question: Which floating-point format has a 5-bit exponent and 10-bit mantissa?
queries._expected_answer: half (FP16) — listed in the precision sign/exponent/mantissa diagram.

queries.question: In what year did NVIDIA acquire Mellanox?
queries._expected_answer: (Refuse — the deck is about CUDA architecture, not corporate M&A history.)

queries._expected_answer: (Refuse — RAG is unrelated to a CUDA architecture deck.)
